arxiv-2108-00361.title: Design of Non-Orthogonal Sequences Using a Two-Stage Genetic Algorithm for Grant-Free Massive Connectivity
arxiv-2108-00361.creator: Nam Yul Yu
arxiv-2108-00361.description: Abstract In massive machine-type communications (mMTC), grant-free access is a key enabler for a massive number of users to be connected to a base station with low signaling overhead and low latency. In this paper, a two-stage genetic algorithm (GA) is proposed to design a new set of user-specific, non-orthogonal, unimodular sequences for uplink grant-free access.

arxiv-2109-01055.title: Quenching factor measurements of neon nuclei in neon gas
arxiv-2109-01055.creator: L. Balogh, C. Beaufort, A. Brossard, J.-F. Caron, M. Chapellier, J.-M. Coquillat, E. C. Corcoran, S. Crawford, A. Dastgheibi Fard, Y. Deng, K. Dering, D. Durnford, C. Garrah, G. Gerbier, I. Giomataris, G. Giroux, P. Gorel, M. Gros, P. Gros, O. Guillaudin, E. W. Hoppe, I. Katsioulas, F. Kelly, P. Kni
arxiv-2109-01055.description: Abstract The NEWS-G collaboration uses Spherical Proportional Counters (SPCs) to search for weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs). In this paper, we report the first measurements of the nuclear quenching factor in neon gas at 2 bar 2\text{\,}\mathrm{b}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{r} using an SPC deployed in a neutron beam at the TUNL facility.

arxiv-2201-10836.title: PARS: P seudo-Label A ware R obust S ample Selection for Learning with Noisy Labels
arxiv-2201-10836.creator: Arushi Goel, Yunlong Jiao & Jordan Massiah, University of Edinburgh, Amazon goel.arushi@gmail.com, {jyunlong, jormas}@amazon.com
arxiv-2201-10836.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Arushi Goel, Yunlong Jiao & Jordan Massiah, University of Edinburgh, Amazon goel.arushi@gmail.com, {jyunlong, jormas}@amazon.com. Acquiring accurate labels on large-scale datasets is both time consuming and expensive. To reduce the dependency of deep learning models on learning from clean labeled data, several recent research efforts are focused on learning with noisy labels. These methods typically fall into three design categories to learn a noise robust model: sample selection approaches, noise robust loss functions, or label correction methods.

arxiv-2210-06518.title: Semi-Supervised Offline Reinforcement Learning with Action-Free Trajectories
arxiv-2210-06518.creator: Qinqing Zheng, Mikael Henaff, Brandon Amos, Aditya Grover
arxiv-2210-06518.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qinqing Zheng, Mikael Henaff, Brandon Amos, Aditya Grover. Natural agents can effectively learn from multiple data sources that differ in size, quality, and types of measurements. We study this heterogeneity in the context of offline reinforcement learning (RL) by introducing a new, practically motivated semi-supervised setting. Here, an agent has access to two sets of trajectories: labelled trajectories containing state, action and reward triplets at every timestep, along with unlabelled trajectories that contain only state and reward information.

arxiv-2303-00548.title: Dynamics of Ball-Chains and Very Elastic Fibres Settling under Gravity in a Viscous Fluid †
arxiv-2303-00548.creator: H. J. Shashank, Yevgen Melikhov, Maria L. Ekiel-Jeżewska
arxiv-2303-00548.description: Abstract We study experimentally the dynamics of one and two ball-chains settling under gravity in a very viscous fluid at a Reynolds number much smaller than unity. We demonstrate that single ball-chains in most cases do not tend to be planar and often rotate, not keeping the ends at the same horizontal level.

arxiv-2304-02101.title: MadEye: Boosting Live Video Analytics Accuracy with Adaptive Camera Configurations
arxiv-2304-02101.creator: Mike Wong 1 , Murali Ramanujam 1 , Guha Balakrishnan 2 , Ravi Netravali 1
arxiv-2304-02101.description: Abstract . Camera orientations (i.e., rotation and zoom) govern the content that a camera captures in a given scene, which in turn heavily influences the accuracy of live video analytics pipelines. However, existing analytics approaches leave this crucial adaptation knob untouched, instead opting to only alter the way that captured images from fixed orientations are encoded, streamed, and analyzed.

arxiv-2403-04741.title: Effects of mechanical stress, chemical potential, and coverage on hydrogen solubility during hydrogen enhanced decohesion of ferritic steel grain boundaries: A first-principles study
arxiv-2403-04741.creator: Abril Azócar Guzmán , 1,2, Rebecca Janisch 1
arxiv-2403-04741.description: Abstract Hydrogen enhanced decohesion (HEDE) is one of the many mechanisms of hydrogen embrittlement, a phenomenon which severely impacts structural materials such as iron and iron alloys. Grain boundaries (GBs) play a critical role in this mechanism, where they can provide trapping sites or act as hydrogen diffusion pathways.

arxiv-2408-01068.title: Higgs boson production at μ + ​ μ + \mu^{+}\mu^{+} colliders
arxiv-2408-01068.creator: Yu Hamada, Ryuichiro Kitano, Ryutaro Matsudo, Shohei Okawa, Ryoto Takai, Hiromasa Takaura, and Lukas Treuer
arxiv-2408-01068.description: Abstract We study Higgs boson production at μ + ​ μ + \mu^{+}\mu^{+} colliders at high energy. Since both initial-state particles are positively charged, there is no W W boson fusion at the leading order, as it requires a W + ​ W − W^{+}W^{-} pair.

Current instruments to measure digital he

pmc-10512531.title: Vaccination coverage in rural Burkina Faso under the effects of COVID-19: evidence from a panel study in eight districts
pmc-10512531.creator: Sarah Cooper, Frank Bicaba, Cheick Oumar Tiendrebeogo, Alice Bila, Abel Bicaba, Thomas Druetz
pmc-10512531.description: BackgroundImproving infant immunization completion and promoting equitable vaccination coverage are crucial to reducing global under-5 childhood mortality. Although there have been hypotheses that the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic would decrease the delivery of health services and immunization campaigns in low- and middle-income countries, the available evidence is still inconclusive.

pmc-11345024.title: Emerging Trends in the Application of Extracellular Vesicles as Novel Oral Delivery Vehicles for Therapeutics in Inflammatory Diseases
pmc-11345024.creator: Mingtang Zeng, Maozhu Liu, Xuelin Tao, Xi Yin, Chao Shen, Xueyan Wang
pmc-11345024.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Inflammation involves complex immune responses where cytokines such as TNF-α, IL-1, and IL-6 promote vasodilation and increased vascular permeability to facilitate immune cell migration to inflammation sites. Persistent inflammation is linked to diseases like cancer, arthritis, and neurodegenerative disorders. Although oral anti-inflammatory drugs are favored for their non-invasiveness and cost-effectiveness, their efficacy is often compromised due to gastrointestinal degradation and limited bioavailability.

pmc-12500857.title: A multi-molecular biomarker assessment of thermal preconditioning in two scleractinian coral species
pmc-12500857.creator: Yohan Didier Louis, Enrico Montalbetti, Valerio Isa, Davide Maggioni, Ludovico Pravettoni, Rebecca Pollutri, Jacopo Gobbato, Simone Montano, Ivan Orlandi, Marina Vai, Silvia Lavorano, Paolo Galli, Davide Seveso
pmc-12500857.description: Coral reefs face escalating threats from rising sea temperatures, triggering widespread mass bleaching and mortality events. Thermal preconditioning, a process in which corals exposed to sublethal thermal stress become more tolerant to subsequent thermal stress, is increasingly recognised as a promising strategy for restoration purposes. However, its underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-12626027.title: A Review Vancomycin Role in Gram Positive Biofilm-Associated Infections: Challenges and Emerging Solutions
pmc-12626027.creator: Ohood S Alharbi, Khulud A Alhazmi, Malaz Gazzaz, Sarah Almuhayya, Faye A Aldehalan, Asim T Sharif, Bayan Redwan, Mohannad A Alzain, Wafaa Alhazmi, Hala Altarawneh, Hassan Ahmad Hasan Alfreahat, Sulaiman Bani Abdel-Rahman, Waiel S Halabi, Rawan Altalhi, Bandar Hasan Saleh, Nabeel Hussain Alhussainy,
pmc-12626027.description: Biofilm-associated infections pose a significant challenge in clinical settings due to their increased resistance to antibiotics and evasion of host immune responses. These infections are responsible for a large proportion of chronic and recurrent infections, leading to prolonged hospital stays, increased healthcare costs, and elevated morbidity and mortality rates.

pmc-13005391.title: Lipid Goal Achievement With Statins Among Statin-Naïve Indian Patients Undergoing Percutaneous Coronary Intervention
pmc-13005391.creator: Mahidhar Jeedigunta, Vivek Veeram Reddy, Ganesh Paramasivam
pmc-13005391.description: BackgroundThe effectiveness of current statin therapy in achieving lipid targets in Indian patients remains uncertain. This observational study aimed to evaluate lipid goal attainment at 1 and 6 months with atorvastatin and rosuvastatin in statin-naïve South Indian patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).MethodsThis prospective, observational, single-center study included 491 statin-naïve patients who underwent PCI between March 2021 and May 2023.

pmc-13092197.title: Bibliometric and trend analysis of the top 100 most-cited articles on anterior lumbar interbody fusion (ALIF)
pmc-13092197.creator: Badr Hafiz, Thamer Alsharif, Abdulaziz Hamzah, Faisal Sukkar, Yousef Bassi, Moaath Alghamdi, Muhammad Tariq, Rakan Bokhari, Saleh Baeesa
pmc-13092197.description: IntroductionAnterior lumbar interbody fusion (ALIF) is a widely utilized spinal procedure supported by an expanding body of literature. However, the structure, influence, and thematic evolution of the most impactful studies remain incompletely characterized. This study aimed to analyze the bibliometric profile of the 100 most-cited ALIF publications.MethodsA bibliometric analysis was performed using the Web of Science Core Collection.

pmc-13154857.title: Patient perspectives on the use of artificial intelligence to support treatment decision making in renal cancer: findings from the KATY project
pmc-13154857.creator: Christina Golna, Chara Tzavara, Pavlos Golnas, Aikaterini Nikitara, Maria Nomikou, George Kapetanakis, Emilia Daghir – Wojtkowiak, Katarzyna Barud, Syed Zulkifil Haider Shah, Alexander Laird, Javier Alfaro, Fabio Massimo Zanzotto, Maria Gazouli, Kyriakos Souliotis
pmc-13154857.description: BackgroundArtificial-Intelligence (AI) empowered tools are increasingly being assessed for treatment selection in cancer. Patient perceptions on their use will be critical for uptake in clinical practice. We investigated patient willingness to endorse an AI-empowered Personalized Medicine (PM) system (the EU Commission funded “KATY”) to support treatment selection in renal cancer and mapped factors that impact on their perspectives.

pmc-13365891.title: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Age-Specific N-Terminal Pro-B-Type Natriuretic Peptide Thresholds for Heart Failure Diagnosis in China: Protocol for a Markov Model–Based Study
pmc-13365891.creator: Changyuan Liu, Jing Wang, Shuangning Ding, Yongze Li, Javad Sarvestan, Shixian Liu, Cheng Han, Evelyn Walter
pmc-13365891.description: BackgroundHeart failure (HF) imposes a substantial clinical and economic burden in China. Although N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) is widely used in the diagnostic pathway for HF, conventional thresholds are largely derived from Western populations and may not be fully applicable to Chinese adults.

pmc-13385299.title: Quercus persica lozenges versus placebo for reducing gag reflex severity in adult dental patients: a randomized double-blind controlled trial
pmc-13385299.creator: Atefeh Mohammadi, Mohsen Taghizadeh, Reza Hosseiniara, Hossien Akbari, Ameneh Taghdisi Kashani
pmc-13385299.description: The gag reflex is a common challenge during dental procedures, often impairing clinical performance and causing patient discomfort. While pharmacological interventions are commonly employed, they can lead to adverse effects or be poorly tolerated. Herbal alternatives with local mucosal activity have gained increasing attention as potentially safer adjuncts.

pmc-13412908.title: Instrumental Learning Approaches in Pre-Professional Music Students: Associations Among Motivation, Strategy and Practice
pmc-13412908.creator: Şehriban Koca, Çağlanur Sakarya, Atakan Kutlu, Alican Gülle, Kıvılcım Pekpak, Aslıhan Ergin
pmc-13412908.description: Instrumental learning in pre-professional music education involves complex associations among motivational orientations, cognitive strategies, and practice habits; however, their individual-level interrelations have received limited empirical attention in domain-specific research. This study examines these associations among pre-professional music students enrolled in Fine Arts High Schools (FAHS) in Türkiye (N = 332).
